final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT s.healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_ratio FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.healtheval), mean_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM status_averages) SELECT sa.healtheval, sa.total_scans, sa.avg_ratio, sa.avg_ratio - mr.value AS difference_from_status_mean FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN mean_ratio mr WHERE mr.value IS NOT NULL
